verdicts.reason: Both break apart the original's main idea: the red T no longer sits behind the copy and ends up as an unrelated block on the far right. The headline is shrunk to tiny five-line stacked text that runs almost from the top edge to the bottom edge, and most of the banner in between is empty blue. A also floats the text at an arbitrary inset with dead space on its left, and its spacing in 'AGAINSTCRUELTY' looks wrong. B is slightly better because it anchors the text to a consistent left margin and keeps the word spacing correct.
